body:
Part of General UI Polish (feature item 1). Buttons and column names show literal action names today: an action button falls back to the action name when the workflow's `labels` dict (D-108) has no entry, and column names come from `Column.label`.

- `default-board.toml` (root project): give every column a human `label` and add `labels` entries for every action.
- `solace_task.action_label` keeps its fallback, but no shipped workflow relies on it.
- Collect the board's, task detail's, Strategy's and Settings' button texts into one label map (in `solace_task`, shared by the pages) so buttons read defined labels, not inline strings: New task, Create task, Archive, Show task, Close All, Dismiss, Save, Edit, Add note, Delete, Copy ID, Answer, Watch, Start, Send, End, Stop, New run.
- The board's column bar (`head_view`) and the Strategy Tasks tab's Column filter use the same labels.

**Tests:** board and strategy view tests that action buttons and column headers show labels for the default workflow; update tests that assert the old literal names.
title: ui: Labels for buttons and columns
